import sys

for line in sys.stdin:
    if line.strip():
        p, k = map(int, line.split())
        if k == 0:
            cycle_length = p - 1
        elif k == 1:
            cycle_length = p
        else:
            cycle_length = -1

        total = 1
        if cycle_length == -1:
            count = 1
            v = k
            while v != 1:
                v = (v * k) % p
                count += 1
            cycle_length = p // count

        for _ in range(cycle_length):
            total = (total * p) % 1000000007

        print(total)
